name: Sikorsky CH-53E Super Stallion (FreddyStoned)
summary: Flyable CH-53E heavy-lift helicopter with a partly clickable cockpit and EFM files.
description: Flyable, standalone CH-53E with a partly clickable cockpit, animated door gunners, an opening tail ramp and a visual-only winch and cargo. Built from the FlightGear CH-53 model (used with permission) with an EFM derived from the CptSmiley and Nibbylots demos. Known issues: autorotation is incomplete and AI landing gear does not work.
